title: Enforce runtime parity with the checked-in memory schema
description: Deep-dive audit 2026-08-08 verified that Schemas/memory.schema.json is not consumed by runtime validation; scripts/tests implement separate rules. The schema can drift and provide false assurance to schema-driven clients. Evidence: Schemas/memory.schema.json and Scripts/Test-MemoryRecords.ps1. Make the schema executable or add parity tests that compare schema and runtime validation.
